title: Field Notes on the Bipeds
hook: You just arrived from orbit. Try to make sense of them.
premise: You are an extraterrestrial scout logging your first afternoon on Earth. Your mission is to decode the daily customs of the native species using ordinary Queens artifacts.
ending: Transmission concluded: the species runs on dough, metal boxes, and small dogs.

stops.title: Specimen Observation Platform
stops.place: Gantry Plaza State Park, Center Blvd & 48th Ave
stops.body: The inhabitants sit along this shoreline staring across murky water at a wall of vertical stone hives.
stops.move: Stand at the railing and count how many small four-legged beasts they lead on leashes.

stops.title: The Combustion Artery
stops.place: Pulaski Bridge pedestrian path, 11th St entrance
stops.body: The bipeds encase themselves in two-ton steel boxes to traverse narrow aerial corridors at great personal expense.
stops.move: Rest your hand on the metal fence until three yellow vehicles pass underneath.

stops.title: Primary Fuel Dispensary
stops.body: A fluorescent bunker crammed with preserved plant extracts, ground legumes, and foil packets designed to sustain vital functions.
stops.move: Buy one small pastry or snack item using coin currency and eat it on the sidewalk.

stops.title: The Transit Tube
stops.body: A suspended iron scaffold where the locals wait in silence for an electric serpent to ingest them.
stops.move: Stand precisely on the platform's yellow tactile edge and listen to the rumble before the train appears.
